summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Innovator Index Autocallable Income Strategy ETF (ACII) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is actively managed. The fund employs a combination of OTC autocallable swap agreements on three major US equity ETFs, laddered over different dates in attempt to generate income and provide a small cushion on the downside risks. ACII was launched on Sep 25, 2025 and is issued by Innovator.
